selection: Two sequential 16-document uniform draws without text cues from the same 64-document fresh-offset frame

rows.note: A compilation of mostly unrelated short science-fiction headlines and review text.
A greeting-card listing gives size, paper, envelope and packaging details.
Furniture descriptions mix materials, finish recommendations and prices.
A named pear has sweetness and texture stated, then restated later.
Color combinations and a population count remain attached to a campaign.
A historical claim is attributed to researchers with time and location context.
A privacy policy distinguishes permissions, legal requirements and cookie choices.
Fundraising participation is linked to conditional support and actions.
An ingredient recurs across prose, episode titles and a recipe list.
A recruiting call to action is conditional on reader interest.
A personal medical narrative links dates and a conditional consequence.
Prints and editions have process, material and numbering attributes.
A charity and its facilities retain distinct funding amounts and dates.
Yarn material, shade count, length and tension stay attached to a product.
A named hat has color and design details across several sentences.
Several distinct spaceflight events and times are linked in a schedule.
Two named sponsors are linked to different contributions and dates.
A named onyx sculpture and the stone properties recur in later prose.
Rich texture of a named body cream is restated across adjacent prose.
A political critique gives conditional writing advice in a list.
A device instruction scopes steps to products and selected input settings.
A machinery FAQ includes cost and configuration questions with conditional answers.
A casting report keeps actors, roles, dates and an agency source distinct.
Advice about arguing has condition-dependent consequences across prose.
An artist interview links quotations, artworks and years.
A named buoyancy aid has size repeated between the title and specifications.
A glasses case listing links color and dimensions to the item.
A webinar article binds speakers, organizations, date and meeting roles.
A short philosophical synopsis remains about the same thinker.
A personal narrative tracks several people and travel plans.
A business pitch conditions follow-up advice and cites a percentage claim.
A research abstract links disease severity to several named brain regions.

caveat: One annotator, 32 short crops and overlapping qualitative tags. A broad relation is not an exact next-token task. This is a larger follow-up to the initial 16, not an independent corpus. Zero observed full V13 patterns does not establish absence from FineWeb. No source prose is exported.
